source_note: Built from the site's source (src/styles/tokens.css, page copy) and mobile screenshots of the offline mock build; lebanontcg.com itself is not reachable from the build environment.

typography.display_feel: Chakra Petch: a squared-off, techy display sans set in heavy-weight ALL CAPS with tight leading. Reads like a card-game UI or a trading terminal, not a luxury brand.
typography.body_feel: Inter regular in soft grey on dark; short, plain sentences.
typography.label_feel: JetBrains Mono, uppercase, wide letter-spacing, small: used for eyebrows, prices and status chips (LIVE AUCTION, CURRENT BID, 01 / 04).

color_palette.rules: Near-black ground with graphite panels. One acid-lime accent (#d6ff3f) for buttons, live chips and a single highlighted word or card. Text on lime is near-black #08090b. The home hero runs one word through a violet-to-lime gradient; use that gradient at most once per ad, on one word. No other hues except the card art itself.

copy_tone.voice: Plain, peer-to-peer, collector-to-collector. Short declarative sentences. States what happens, not how amazing it is. Honest about how the site works (you handle the deal).
examples_from_brand: We connect collectors. You handle the deal.
List what you own, message the person who has what you want. No checkout, no fees, you agree the terms yourselves.
List your first card — it takes about a minute.
copy_tone.signature_moves: ALL-CAPS display headlines of 2-6 words; a lowercase grey sentence underneath that explains the mechanism; mono uppercase eyebrow above the headline (PEER-TO-PEER · 42 CARDS LISTED); acid-lime pill buttons with uppercase mono text.

dos: Say what the seller does: list, price, message, meet
Name the real games (Pokémon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana) only as text
Use the lime accent on exactly one element besides the CTA
Show the real mobile UI from the screenshots, unaltered
donts: No claims of payment protection, escrow, shipping or buyer guarantees: the site has no checkout
Do not promise free listing forever: listing is free 'for now' and paid plans are planned. 'No commission' / 'nothing taken out of your sales' stays true
No official Pokémon / Yu-Gi-Oh! / MTG card art or logos (not licensed)
No neon glow, lens flares, holographic rainbow effects or random gradients
No fake UI: never redraw or invent screens, prices or usernames
visual_register: Dark product-UI editorial: a phone or a clean crop of the real app on a near-black stage, precise lime accents, a lot of quiet dark space.
